Downloads

Choose a destination for every file before it downloads.

Downloads

Choose whether each download asks where to save. When asking is off, files go to the folder below with a unique name; existing files are not replaced. The Save As dialog is provided by your operating system. Browser updates use Downloads separately.
Download folder
Used for automatic downloads and as the starting folder for Save As. Empty means your system Downloads folder.
Ask where to save each download
On: choose a name and location each time. Off: save automatically to the download folder.
Notify when a download finishes
A system notification while PsychoVault is in the background. The rail badge and the in-window message happen either way.
Settings category

Extensions

Install and manage compatible browser extensions.

Extensions

Extensions are loaded the way a browser’s “load unpacked” works: install an unpacked folder or a .crx file. Web store one-click installation is not supported. Extensions run inside every tab and can read the pages you visit - only install ones you trust, and note that no signature is verified for a crx here.
What actually works. Content scripts, page changes, request blocking through the webRequest API, storage, messaging, and - through PsychoVault’s own shim - proxy and privacy settings, which is what a browser VPN extension needs to send traffic through a tunnel. What does not exist in this engine: declarativeNetRequest (the MV3 rules engine), native messaging and a toolbar to click. Known incompatible permissions are flagged below, but this is not a guarantee an extension will work.
Proton VPN

Installed by default. PsychoVault ships a build of Proton’s own browser extension, compiled from Proton’s GPL-3.0 source. It appears in the list below like any other extension - open its window to sign in and connect.

Sign in with your own Proton account. Use the VPN button on the sidebar to connect or disconnect. A connection indicator alone does not prove there are no DNS or WebRTC leaks.

If the VPN says connected but your IP does not change, press Check what proxy is in use. It reports what the browser would really do with your traffic, per profile.
Press Check install to see what the bundled extension did at startup.

Performance

Resource limits, sleeping tabs, and battery saving.

Governor

CPU limit
Lowers this browser's scheduler priority so games and captures get the cores.
Battery saver
Battery saver: lowers priority further and sleeps tabs after three minutes.
Sleep tabs after
Minutes before idle tabs sleep; 0 means never. Pinned tabs never sleep. Battery saver can sleep tabs sooner.
Never sleep these sites - one hostname per line.
Bandwidth cap
Downloads are paused and resumed to hold the average, so this is a duty cycle, not a hard ceiling.
Battery saver on unplug
Turn the limiter and fast tab sleep on by itself when the power lead comes out.

Spelling

Configure spell checking and your personal dictionary.

Spelling

Spell-check text you type in pages
Turns the whole feature on or off: red underlines in a page's own fields, the suggestions in the right-click menu and “Add to dictionary”. The address bar, the palette and this page are deliberately not checked.
PsychoVault's own checker
This is what draws the red line and offers “the” for “teh”: a built-in word list plus your own words, checked in the page. Turn it off only if you do not want any checking.
Languages
Which word list the checker prefers: en uses the English list; any other language has no dictionary here because only English ships. Blank uses your system locale; case does not matter.
Dictionary source
A folder or mirror holding <lang>.dic and <lang>.aff Hunspell files. Nothing is fetched from here; the built-in checker is what makes the feature work.
spellchecking on | engine: PsychoVault built-in | locale en-US
Your words - one per line. Saving adds what is new and removes what you deleted, so this list is the dictionary.
Words I have added - one per line.

Passwords

Manage your local encrypted password vault.

Passwords

vault on - locked - 0 entries
Vault enabled
Off means the browser reads nothing from the vault and writes nothing to it.
Auto-lock after
Wipes the decrypted vault from memory. Copying a password starts a one-minute lock on its own.
The vault is currently encrypted by your operating system. You can optionally set a master password.
New master password
Master password
Import and encrypted backups - unlock the vault first. CSV exports contain plaintext passwords: keep the file private and delete it securely when you are finished. Imports and restores merge entries and skip matching site and username; they never replace existing entries. Keep the backup password safe - it cannot be recovered.
Backup password
Vault filling is manual, HTTPS-only and limited to the same host (with www treated as equivalent). Cross-origin frames are not filled.
No entries yet.
Add an entry by hand - or right-click a password field on a real site and choose “Save password for this site”.

Accessibility & language

Translate pages and adjust the browser interface for comfort.

Page translation

Translate pages to
This is the destination language. The page's original language is detected automatically.
Choose Menu → Translate current page or press Ctrl+K and search “translate”. Google Translate receives the page URL and fetches its contents; PsychoVault asks first and opens the translated copy in a new tab. This needs internet access and may not work on every site. Do not use it for private or sensitive pages.

Accessibility

High-contrast interface
Uses brighter text, stronger borders, and a clear accent in PsychoVault's controls and Settings.
Reduce motion
Reduces browser-interface animation and asks websites to minimize transitions and scrolling effects.
Always show tab close buttons
Keeps each close button visible instead of only showing it on hover or focus.
Keyboard tip: use Ctrl++ / Ctrl+- to zoom the current page and the left/right arrow keys while focused on a tab to switch tabs. Keyboard focus is outlined.

About

Version and project information.

About

Error log
Logs can contain private paths or URLs. Review and redact them before sharing.
A report you can copy when something goes wrong. It contains no page content.
If an update fails while Proton VPN is on, disconnect it and retry. PsychoVault does not bypass the VPN automatically. It removes an updater-downloaded installer only after the new version starts and the file is verified unchanged; older untracked installers are kept.
PsychoVault
Browser application (this UI, tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads, blocking) and the rendering engine: written for this project.
Bookmark, history and settings files live in your user data folder.
Licensed MIT. Third-party components under their own licences - see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
Automatic updates
Checked quietly once at startup, and only on packaged Windows x64 builds. This runs the same check and tells you the answer even when it fails.
